focused_selection.text:
Session date: 3:56 pm on 4 November, 2022
[D26:2] Nate: Wow Joanna, nice work! How did it go with those producer meetings?
[D26:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! The meetings went really well. I felt confident discussing my script and vision and they seemed interested and excited. They loved the elements of self-discovery in it. It was so validating to be taken seriously. I'm feeling hopeful and inspired about the future!
[D26:4] Nate: Way to go, Joanna! Putting yourself out there is really brave and winning recognition for your hard work feels great. It's just like when I win a video game tournament - it feels awesome! I'm so proud of you and so glad you're feeling hopeful and inspired.
[D26:5] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot. Writing isn't always easy but moments like these make me appreciate it. I'm so thankful for all the opportunities. Last week, I found these old notebooks with my early writings - it was cool to see how far I've come.
[D26:6] Nate: That's cool! You must love seeing how you've grown as an artist. Is there a favorite piece from your early writings that stands out to you?
[D26:7] Joanna: Yup, I still remember this story from when I was 10. It was about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway. Maybe even back then, I was inspired by stories about finding courage and taking risks. It's still a part of my writing today.
[D26:8] Nate: You obviously have a passion for writing, and it's funny the story was about a turtle! Their resilience is so inspiring! Take courage and keep pushing yourself with your writing. Great job!
[...]
Session date: 8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022
[D27:6] Joanna: I am writing another movie script! It's a love story with lots of challenges. I've put lots of hard work into it and I'm hoping to get it on the big screen.
[D27:7] Nate: Woah Joanna, that's incredible! I remember when you started working on these sorta things. It's crazy to see how far you've gotten! You've really got a thing for writing, huh? Where'd you get the idea for it?
[D27:8] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Writing has always been a passion of mine. I got the idea for this script from a dream. How have your turtles been? I haven't seen pictures of them in a while!
[D27:9] Nate: Great actually! These little guys sure bring joy to my life! Watching them is so calming and fascinating. I've really grown fond of them. So, what about you, Joanna? What brings you happiness?
[D27:10] Joanna: Creating stories and watching them come alive gives me happiness and fulfillment. Writing has been such a blessing for me.

Session date: 10:55 am on 24 June, 2022
[D16:11] Joanna: Awesome! I'm going to make it for my family this weekend - can't wait!
[D16:12] Nate: Nice one, Joanna! Hope you and your family like it. Let me know how it went!
[D16:13] Joanna: Sure thing! They love it when I make them new things!
[D16:14] Nate: Then I have no doubt they'll love the icecream!
[D16:15] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.
[D16:16] Nate: Can't wait to hear about it. Have a great day! Take care.
Session date: 2:34 pm on 10 July, 2022
[D17:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, check this out! I won my fourth video game tournament on Friday! It was awesome competing and showing off my skills - and the victory was indescribable. I'm really proud that I can make money doing what I love. This one was online!
[D17:2] Joanna: Congrats, Nate! That's awesome! So proud of you. Your hard work really paid off - keep it up! BTW, I took a road trip for research for my next movie while you were winning. Much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.
[D17:3] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your support means a lot to me. That road trip sounds great! Where did you go? Did you discover any interesting places?
[D17:4] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Appreciate your kind words. I went to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest. Got to see some lovely scenery and historic buildings. Checked out the library there, it had a cool old book collection!
[D17:5] Nate: That place looks interesting! Did you find any cool books there?
[D17:6] Joanna: I stumbled upon this super cool book from the 1900s with stories and sketches - so awesome to read about the town and the people living there!

Session date: 1:07 pm on 25 February, 2022
[D4:11] Nate: I hear that, taking your mind of something like that is very challenging. What's the new one about?
[D4:12] Joanna: It's about a thirty year old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss. Somewhat similar to the last one, but hey, that's just the kind of thing I'm inspired to write about!
[D4:13] Nate: Interesting! That's a deep topic. Love to hear more about it.
[D4:14] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It's my own story. The main character is dealing with some tough stuff: loss and trying to figure out who they are. They take a road trip to heal and grow.
[D4:15] Nate: Wow, Joanna, that sounds awesome. I love stories that tackle important issues. What inspired you to this one?
[D4:16] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It was inspired by personal experiences and my own journey of self-discovery.
[D4:17] Nate: Wow, Joanna, that takes guts! I can't wait to see it all come together. I'm also pumped to see how your first one will do!
[...]
Session date: 6:59 pm on 18 March, 2022
[D5:19] Joanna: Appreciated! I think just having someone to support me throughout the whole process is such a blessing. It gives me the motivation to keep pushing forward.
[D5:20] Nate: Glad to hear my support makes a difference, Joanna. I'm here for you!
[D5:21] Joanna: Always good to hear! See you later!
Session date: 1:43 pm on 24 March, 2022
[D6:1] Nate: Hey Joanna! Long time no talk, how's it going? Crazy stuff's been happening since we last chatted.
[D6:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Been quite a ride - in a good way - had an audition yesterday for a writing gig.

Session date: 3:35 pm on 12 May, 2022
[D11:8] Nate: I wish I could have been there! Your hikes sound like a blast.
[D11:9] Joanna: It was awesome, Nate. The sound of that place and the beauty of nature made me so calm and peaceful. Everything else faded away and all that mattered was the present.
[D11:10] Nate: That's great. Glad you found a spot that calms you down - nature sure can be a break from the craziness.
[D11:11] Joanna: Nature totally inspires me and it's so calming to be surrounded by its beauty. Hiking has opened up a whole new world for me and I feel like a different person now.
[D11:12] Nate: Wow, Jo, that's really cool! It's great to have something that gets those creative juices flowing.
[D11:13] Joanna: I always feel like I could write a whole movie when I'm out there in cool places like that!
[D11:14] Nate: Wow! That's really cool that it inspires you that much! For me I just get deep in thought and think about my life or new recipes.
[D11:15] Joanna: I think about my life too sometimes when I'm out and about, but there was something special about these trails that made me feel like writing a drama.
[D11:16] Nate: Hey, we should go together sometime, don't you think? Maybe I'll start to think of a drama myself and publish my own screenplay.
[D11:17] Joanna: Haha, now that would be something! Sure, you should come down and join me on the trails sometime!
[D11:18] Nate: Sounds like a plan! Thanks for the invite Joanna!
[D11:19] Joanna: Sure thing Nate! See you later!
[D11:20] Nate: See ya!

Session date: 8:16 pm on 25 October, 2022
[D25:6] Joanna: Seeing my characters I worked so hard on come alive was my favorite part. It felt like they jumped off the page and became real - it was totally surreal.
[D25:7] Nate: Wow Joanna, those drawings are really incredible! What inspired you to create them?
[D25:8] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! They're visuals of the characters to help bring them alive in my head so I can write better.
[...]
[D25:10] Joanna: I got ideas from everywhere: people I know, stuff I saw, even what I imagined. It's cool to see how an idea takes shape into a person with their own wants, worries, and wishes.
[D25:11] Nate: Wow Joanna, that's so cool! It's amazing how our imaginations can bring ideas to life. Can you tell me more about the character on the left in the photo?
[D25:12] Joanna: Nope! You'll just have to watch the movie and find out for yourself!
[D25:13] Nate: You got it. I was already planning on watching it, but talking to you about it makes me want to watch it even more!
[D25:14] Joanna: Awesome! Well enough about me, what have you been up to?
[D25:15] Nate: I was bored today, so I just took my turtles out for a walk.
[D25:16] Joanna: Sound fun! Did they have a good time?
[D25:17] Nate: Of course! They look tired from all the walking, so they're relaxing in the tank right now.
[D25:18] Joanna: Aww, they're so cute! What do they eat?
